name: Runner Extras - Bundle Page Over Dependency Table
brief: Proves issue #2452: a bundle-compiled page whose SourceTable names a table shipping precompiled in a dependency .app resolves and builds a live record, not a navigation mock.
description: Kept as its OWN app group (not folded into microsoft-dependencies or standalone-suites) because both of those already declare a `Record "Payment Method"`/`Record Resource` variable elsewhere in the suite, which pre-populates RecordPatches._parsedTables by TABLE ID during that OTHER codeunit's compile — masking the exact by-NAME resolution gap this suite exists to prove (GetSourceTableIdForPage's by-name loop against _parsedTables only ever sees a bundle-parsed table; the fix falls back to TryPopulateParsedTableByName's dependency lookup). This suite's only Record variable of the target table type is INSIDE the codeunit that also declares the page, so the by-name fallback is the only path that can populate it.
